title: Chicken Tacos
subtitle: spiced chicken in flour tortillas
excerpt: Strips of spiced chicken thigh cooked quickly in a pan and served in warm flour tortillas. Add soured cream, lime-spiked avocado, and a little chilli. This is a quick weeknight dinner that everyone likes.
sourceNotes: Tacos are a cornerstone of Mexican street food, eaten across every region of the country. The flour tortilla version is more common in northern Mexico, particularly in the states of Sonora and Chihuahua.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Season the chicken up to 24 hours ahead and keep in the fridge.

content.text: Slice the chicken thinly so it cooks fast. A very hot pan gives you a little char on the edges, which adds a lot of flavour. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side.

items.prepNote: use 2 ripe avocados, mashed with lime juice and salt

content.text: Mix the chicken with the smoked paprika, cumin, garlic, oil, and salt. Leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Make the avocado: mash 2 ripe avocados with lime juice, salt, and a pinch of chilli. Set aside.
Heat a frying pan over high heat until very hot. Add the chicken in a single layer. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes without stirring until charred underneath.
Stir and cook for another 2 minutes until cooked through. Remove from heat.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan over medium heat, 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, avocado, and soured cream. Serve straight away.

items.symptom: Chicken is steaming instead of charring
items.cause: Pan not hot enough or too much chicken at once
items.fix: Use a very hot pan and cook in batches. Crowding the pan traps steam and stops browning.
Warm each tortilla in a dry pan until pliable. Wrap in a clean cloth to keep them warm and soft.
Slice to about 1cm thickness and remove from heat as soon as it is cooked through. Chicken thigh is more forgiving than breast.

content.text: Tacos are the everyday street food of Mexico and one of the country's most important culinary traditions. The word taco is thought to refer to the small charges used by silver miners, suggesting working-class origins. Flour tortilla versions are most common in the northern states of Sonora and Chihuahua. The global spread of tacos makes them one of the most widely eaten foods in the world.
